verdict.rationale: General marketing language claims sales-cycle automation and AI agents handling tasks (salesforce-docs-11, salesforce-docs-18), and a community comment notes quickly building a timed-email automation in SFDC (salesforce-comm-2), suggesting some trigger-based workflow capability exists. However, the pack never names or documents Flow Builder/Process Builder or specific mechanics for record updates, task creation, and notification triggers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of trigger/workflow builder tools, examples of record-update automations, task-creation automation, and notification automation with independent verification.
